TIER_0_CRITICAL.label: CRITICAL — statistical validation failed
TIER_0_CRITICAL.action: Halt automated production decisioning on this scorecard. Escalate immediately to the model owner. Do not resume production use until the model passes Stage 06 validation.

TIER_1_RECALIBRATE.label: Recalibration recommended
TIER_1_RECALIBRATE.action: Score-level population drift or a significant fairness disparity indicates the model's fitted assumptions no longer match the current population. Schedule a full recalibration (re-run Stages 02-07 on refreshed data) and review whether the affected features/segments need structural changes, not just refitting.

TIER_2_ESCALATE.label: Escalate for review
TIER_2_ESCALATE.action: Material signals present but not yet conclusive (e.g. a fairness flag without statistical significance, or several features drifting without the overall score drifting). A human review is warranted before deciding whether recalibration is needed.

TIER_3_MONITOR.label: Monitor
TIER_3_MONITOR.action: Minor or moderate signals present, below escalation thresholds. No action required now. Re-run this review next monitoring cycle and watch for a worsening trend.

TIER_4_NO_ACTION.label: No action
TIER_4_NO_ACTION.action: No signals flagged. Continue routine monitoring.
